fusions.name: Measured Distance
fusions.desc: A cut of air at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rote Whirl
fusions.desc: A spin of cutting air that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves you moving 15% faster for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Again From the Top
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and carries you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Economy of Motion
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
